name: chess-break
description: A Claude Code mod for chess tactics training while Claude works: Lichess puzzles by theme, missed ones reviewed until learned, progress per theme

autoOpen.title: Open while Claude works
autoOpen.description: Opens the training pane when Claude starts a turn

promptLine.title: Puzzle line under the prompt
promptLine.description: While the pane is hidden, the end of the line under the prompt shows the puzzle: theme, whose move, the last move, the streak

gameSound.title: Sound when the opponent moves
gameSound.description: In a Lichess game with the pane hidden, a short sound joins the toast. macOS and the desktop app only

ratedPuzzles.title: Rated puzzles
ratedPuzzles.description: Signed in to Lichess, puzzles count for your puzzle rating. Off, they are casual: Lichess still marks them as played. c in the pane switches it

source.title: Puzzles from
source.description: lichess (by theme, needs the network), chesscom (Chess.com's daily puzzles, no themes) or offline (1,469 puzzles shipped with the mod)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; English otherwise
